text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Um, excuse me...! 
We held a party at the Ritto Dorm once 
before."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone got to do whatever they 
wanted—playing games, chatting, 
eating food, enjoying their time 
freely..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Just like then, what if we eat—have a 
barbecue— 
while letting everyone freely play 
whatever they like?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I see! I had thought of the BBQ and 
recreation as separate matters... 
but you're proposing we combine the two!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Then hey, why not just move the whole 
venue to the beach? Drinking coffee, 
beach volleyball, splitting 
watermelons—you can do pretty much all of 
it by the sea!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Eat what you want, drink what you want, 
play how you want! 
In other words—a 'Beach Party'!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: A beach party...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that sounds wonderful...! 
Thank you. I'll flesh it out a bit more 
and propose it at the next committee 
meeting!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
Heh-heh, quite a transformation. A roaring 
success, wouldn't you say, Air 
Groove-kun?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I'm surprised myself. 
...I owe you all my thanks."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"If we want to make the deadline, 
something like this... 
Hmm, but since it's a party, maybe more 
like..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"If we want to make it special for 
everyone... 
something truly unforgettable..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(And so, the next day. 
I drew up a simple proposal and submitted 
it to the committee—)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"It's been decided: 'A Joint Beach Party 
with the BBQ Executive Committee'! 
Thank you so much for all your input, 
everyone...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"The pleasure is mine, Suzuka-kun. As head 
of the BBQ committee, I shall give it my 
all! 
Our goal: the greatest beach party in 
history!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Fired up by this new endeavor, 
we steadily moved forward with 
preparations for the beach party—)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Fuji-senpai gave me advice that a dress 
code creates a sense of unity. 
But I haven't been able to think of a good 
outfit..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm! Then what about swimsuits? They're 
flashy and easy to move in. 
Above all, for Umamusume of your age, I'm 
sure cute outfits would be a delight, 
yes?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Swimsuits...! Right, that would make it 
easy to go in the water too... 
Yeah, thank you, Tachyon. I'll propose 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"The blueprint's right there! And the 
things we gotta finish today are this and 
this! 
If you're not sure about anything, ask me, 
Cafe, or Suzuka!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Which means, you guys! 
We don't have much time, so let's power 
through! Let's go!"

text_block_list.name: Pokke's Crew
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"A-Amazing... 
She brought this entire crowd together in 
an instant..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"—We've successfully secured permission to 
use the beach. Since the area has 
expanded, 
there have been requests to set up a drink 
bar, but..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"A drink bar, huh. Ordering extra drinks 
is fine, but hiring 
an outside vendor to handle sales would 
stretch the budget too thin."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"In that case... what if the students 
serve the drinks? 
We could recruit volunteers and have them 
work in shifts... maybe?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (And so, each day flew by like the wind—)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Haah, haah, haah, haah! 
—...Hah!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(............ 
...Tomorrow is finally the beach party.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(—We haven't overlooked anything in the 
preparations, right? The swimsuits 
arrived, 
the decorations met our quota, the shift 
schedule is made... Yeah. It'll be fine.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"... 
...What a beautiful view."

text_block_list.name: Energetic Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"—Beach volleyball, watermelon splitting, 
beach flags, and... 
Wait, there's even a DJ booth? Does that 
mean we can play whatever tracks we like?"

text_block_list.name: Gluttonous Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh~! Did you see the mocktails at the 
drink bar? 
They put so much effort into them. I can't 
wait~!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(...I wonder if this will be an 
unforgettable day for everyone.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (...And for me, too.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, I should head back soon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Cafe, Cafe, Caaafe! Aren't you ready yet, 
Cafe?! 
If we don't hurry, the party will start 
without us!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"We still have time, please wait... 
...More importantly, you seem unusually 
excited today..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Why, of course I am! 
Today's data is nothing short of the 
ultimate dessert of this summer training 
camp!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"................Data, you say... 
It seemed to me like you were feeling 
something more than that, though..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"The beach flags, the water gun fight, the 
fireworks... 
You were enjoying them quite... genuinely, 
weren't you...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
—Heh-heh, quite the keen observer, aren't 
you, Cafe?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps because I view the brain as a 
mere cluster of neurons, 
I have a hard time reacting to things 
straightforwardly!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...And yet, well. It seems I'm not 
completely cynical either.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Memories are fluid things. Through 
repeated recollection, they can transform 
into something entirely different. What 
one might call a false memory."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"So unless one possesses a truly 
extraordinary constitution, 
remembering everything perfectly is an 
utter impossibility."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Even so.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Even if these declarative memories were 
replaced with something entirely 
different, 
as long as the emotions they evoke remain 
unchanged, that is enough. That is how I 
feel."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Tachyon-san...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...I must admit, I've grown quite 
sentimental. 
Now then, Cafe, surely you are finished 
changing?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Oh boy! Clear skies! Clear skies! Perfect 
weather for a party— 
Wait, why are you still hesitating over 
there?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Please wait... the sunlight is a bit too 
bright... 
Wait, where is Pokke—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Oh, there you are!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Lookin' good, Cafe, Tachyon! 
Nice, looks like you're fired up!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Um... could you please not shout right in 
my ear...?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, we're gettin' ready for a beach 
volleyball tournament, 
wanna join? It's gonna be a blast!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I apologize, but I expect to be quite 
busy collecting data today. 
Well, if whatever you're doing proves 
interesting, I might participate."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Then it's settled, you're in! 
It's a party, after all, let's have fun 
until we drop!"
